annotations.title: Get today's listed prices for a robot model

description: Get today's listed price of every listing BotInfo's daily price watch read for a robot model, across the maker's own store and dealers: the listing name, price in USD, stock flag and read date. Dealers are labelled by letter, not named; the maker's store is named. A listed price is not a quote: taxes, shipping and options can change the total. Today's read only, no price history. Use it to see the spread of prices for one model on one day.
